title: WSDG: Update Qt version used
description:
We're building the 4.6 packages against 6.9.3 in order to fix #20725.
Update the development guide to that.

Update the various comments around the Qt LTS branch, since Qt no
longer provides binary packages of the LTS branch for non-commerical
customers. (Or source packages on any useful time scale.)

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
